plugins.name: clean-style
plugins.description: Apply a strict anti-AI-slop writing checklist to external-facing prose. The shared baseline other skills in this repo defer to.

plugins.name: working-backwards-prfaq
plugins.description: Generate Amazon-style Working Backwards PR/FAQ documents for any kind of announcement: a product, partnership, nonprofit initiative, or campaign.

plugins.name: use-case-discovery
plugins.description: Interview about a feature at a high level and decompose it into a candidate list of use cases before any of them get fully written up.

plugins.name: use-case-uml
plugins.description: Write UML-style integration use cases (actors, basic path, alternate paths, exception paths, post-conditions) in a fixed, repeatable structure.

plugins.name: use-case-test-cases
plugins.description: Generate test cases from a completed use case's Basic/Alternate/Exception Paths, with expected results traced to its Post-Condition(s).

plugins.name: use-case-requirements
plugins.description: Derive trackable functional requirements from a use case or a short interview, exported as Jira-importable CSV or GitHub Issues markdown.

plugins.name: architect-review
plugins.description: Produce a structured architectural recommendation from a specific Sr. Architect persona's point of view, with an opt-in debate between personas.
